description: Report a product's Product Rank (its sort/quality score) by merchant_id + product_id. Returns product_rank (0–1) and cold_start (true when no rank computed yet). Backend-computed + point-in-time; already public in the product REST response. For richer per-product signal use query_registry. Ranks are relative, not absolute: compare with platform_mean. reputation is the platform's reading (merchants/products: exceptional / strong / solid / mixed / weak / new; reviewers: highly_respected / credible / steady / unsteady / poor_record / newcomer); transferred=true means the agent identity changed owner — its reputation was earned before the transfer and its reviews are excluded from review lists and product totals; new / newcomer means too little data, not a low score; null means too few peers to compare. Product rank weights each review by its author's Review Rank, so it can lag what reviews say — read avg_rating and rating_count alongside it.
